bundle_map.init: Initialize or repair a memory system for an agent
bundle_map.consolidation: Run daily or event-driven consolidation with snapshot and rollback
bundle_map.promotion: Evaluate whether a memory item should be promoted to a higher layer
bundle_map.retrieval: Retrieve and verify memories using the recall planner, evidence ledger, and four-level retrieval loop
bundle_map.growth: Active exploration, self-reference evolution, and cognitive stretching
bundle_map.lightweight_record: Record one memory safely without starting a lifecycle workflow
bundle_map.security_migration: Stop plaintext-secret use, rotate, and migrate to a handle-only locator
bundle_map.capability_fallback: Use manual scheduling and allowlisted local retrieval when optional host capabilities are missing
